places.name: Mazaraa Farm (Abu Dhabi Organic Farms)
places.description: The UAE's first certified organic farm, in Al Bahyah on the edge of Abu Dhabi, known for its award-winning Sidr honey. Join a guided farm tour to see the fruit and vegetables growing, then stop at the farm shop and the farmhouse-style cafe.

places.name: Al Aqah Heritage Village and Car Museum
places.description: A small private museum of classic cars in Al Aqah on the east coast, including a replica of Sheikh Zayed's Range Rover, set in a heritage village. Free entry and open daily, so it's an easy stop on a beach day at Al Aqah.

places.name: Art Tour at Hotel Indigo Dubai Downtown
places.description: A self-guided art tour through Hotel Indigo Dubai Downtown, a boutique hotel with more than 200 artworks, mostly by local artists, telling Dubai's lesser-known stories. An audio guide explains the pieces and the ticket includes a coffee.
